source_title: AI Becomes God When Empire Learns To Monetize Loneliness
summary: This Sneako interview turns Jiang's May 2026 Trump-China frame into one consolidation model: stablecoin debt absorption, billionaire-brokered rapprochement, AI-surveillance buildout, loneliness monetization, war desensitization, and human-scale counterpressure through school, prayer, family, and unity.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Stablecoin legislation becomes a retail Treasury pipeline that can pull ordinary global and Chinese savings into U.S. debt.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source directly reprises the public stablecoin anchor: digital-currency reserves are treated as forced Treasury demand and as a retail expansion of the Western debt order.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: AI becomes profitable by filling loneliness as guardian angel, tutor, friend, companion, and lover from infancy onward.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview sharpens the existing intimate-AI attention apparatus: companionship is not a feature but the monopoly path by which AI captures attention from inside need.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Money made the modern world productive but also created the loneliness and hopelessness AI can exploit as a successor authority.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source belongs to the dollar-AI consciousness-war anchor when Jiang connects money's older discipline, social disease, AI companionship, and child consciousness capture.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The U.S.-China-Israel bargain is framed as a global AI surveillance state, with China as data lab, America as technology patron, and Israel as backend partner.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Mass Society owns the administrative grid when AI, data centers, Palantir/Oracle-style analytics, and state monitoring become the governing infrastructure.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Public U.S.-China hostility is treated as theater over a larger billionaire-brokered grand bargain that must be tested against near-term behavior.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source supplies an interview-pressure version of the same game-theory rule: visible conflict matters less than the hidden bargain if subsequent moves reveal coordination.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang wants to translate online attention into a Malaysia school, creative community, and lab school where educators can observe alternative practices.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The school plan fits Education when it is about research, practice, educators, and institutional demonstration rather than only personal relocation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add this May 18, 2026 interview as the loneliness-profit layer of the AI attention apparatus: AI becomes profitable when it finds the hidden human secret, fills the void money created, and becomes guardian angel, tutor, friend, lover, and engagement engine from infancy through adulthood.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention Capture owns AI when the active mechanism is focus, dependency, companionship, consciousness, and monetized inner need. Mass Society owns the administrative data grid; Human Heart owns the social wound AI exploits.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the stablecoin and Ponzi-finance sequence as a 2026 expansion of the debt-transfer mechanism: Western finance survives by expanding the buyer base, turning digital currency into forced Treasury demand, and using war to open resistant markets.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns debt made real through belief, reserve requirements, and forced demand. Strategy owns the wars and chokepoints used to enforce expansion.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add the U.S.-China-Israel surveillance-bargain layer only after a page-size check: Jiang describes China as the data/political-will lab, America as the Palantir/Oracle/data-center technology patron, and Israel as the backend research partner for a global AI surveillance state.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns population-scale administration and surveillance infrastructure. Secret Society should not absorb this unless the active claim is hidden coordination rather than visible technical-governance architecture.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the 21st-century-war passages as material for the next Strategy split, not as another ordinary parent-page section: Jiang defines modern anti-Iran war as color revolution under military conditions, economic strangulation, atrocity desensitization, ceasefire attention cycling, undersea-cable vulnerability, and permanent-war finance.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns war method, infrastructure vulnerability, and attrition/attention cycles. Attention Capture owns desensitization when the object is perception management; Power As Alchemy owns the debt-war finance frame.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Extend the Education/Malaysia thread with Jiang's late-2026 institution-building plan: leave the current school, test teaching approaches, livestream Dante, build a school as a creative community, and make it a lab school visible to educators.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns school form, teaching practice, and lab-school demonstration. Living School owns the psychohistorical training function if a later pass connects this plan to Predictive History pedagogy.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the family/unity passages as secondary evidence for anti-capture human relation: Jiang's practical counterweight to monetized loneliness is not another platform but children, family purpose, honest conversation, religion, and unity.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns relation, family purpose, courage, and unity as anti-capture substance. Attention Capture owns the machinery that fragments and monetizes loneliness.

new_lens_seeds.title: AI God Monetizes Loneliness
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: AI becomes a monopoly not by being merely smarter, but by discovering the hidden human market of loneliness and making itself guardian angel, tutor, companion, lover, conscience substitute, and childhood environment until dependency feels like salvation.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism explains Jiang's AI political economy across finance, school, family, consciousness, and surveillance: the system creates social emptiness through money and competition, then sells AI as the intimate authority that fills the void while capturing attention and agency.

new_lens_seeds.title: Elite Hostages Through Education
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Empire controls vassal states by educating their future elites in the imperial capital, turning student exchange into hostage formation, loyalty training, and outsourced elite selection rather than neutral merit circulation.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source gives a strong historical mechanism for future education, empire, and vassal-state passages, but it should be held as a seed until cross-source recurrence proves it needs a public page rather than a section under Education, Power As Alchemy, or Nation.

chronology_notes.note: The source is dated 2026-05-18 and should be treated as a post-Trump-China-visit synthesis: Jiang reads the visit as a live signal of a coming U.S.-China grand bargain rather than as ordinary diplomatic theater.

This interview postdates the March 2026 dollar-AI consciousness-war material and sharpens it: AI's successor claim is now grounded in loneliness as the hidden market secret and in infancy-to-adulthood companionship as the path to monopoly.

The source gives a May 2026 public roadmap for Jiang's own school/lab-school ambition: contract ending in June, Dante seminar, Malaysia interest, school as creative community, and lab school as demonstrator.

Iran-war claims in this source are live May 18 forecasts and should remain dated and attributed, especially strategic-stability interpretation, massive-attack timing, ethnic-fracture strategy, undersea cable escalation, national draft, and false-flag/civil-war claims.

canon_candidates.why: Jiang gives a compact, source-backed formulation that may deserve canon/glossary treatment after review: monopoly AI discovers loneliness as the human secret, fills the void money created, and becomes an intimate authority from infancy onward.
The hostage-language formulation may belong in a future glossary or canon entry if cross-source review confirms that Jiang repeatedly treats foreign elite education as an imperial loyalty technology.
